manifest_description.message: A professional online video downloader for saving videos such as mp4,m3u8,hls,live.

filter_lead.message: Video which the size smaller than this value will not be captured

tips_text_1.message: Some videos may not be captured until they are played. If the target video is not in the list, try to play it, or refresh the page.

tips_text_2.message: If it still doesn't work after trying, download it forcibly with "recording mode".

no_video.message: Video cannot be recorded, or video does not exist!

popup_modal_body.message: Try to choose a fixed resolution before recording (if the video has this option). Because auto-resolution may produce frames of different size, causing the video to be split.
